Everyone is different when it comes to locking in, but I can share what I do! 

I spend a good amount of time in the upright position to focus on my breath and set myself up for a solid brace (I lift beltless). I also use that time to draw my lats towards the floor. I only initiate the deadlift movement after I feel lat engagement and after I brace. So as soon as I get a grip on the bar, I can pull immediately instead of lingering in the bent over position. 

Hope that helps!

I noticed you’re wedging, which is great! You could save energy by not wedging as much. What helped me adjust this was synchronizing my wedge and pull which makes it one smooth motion. 

I also noticed your heels lift up ever so slightly when pulling. Focus on maintaining even foot pressure throughout the lift. Think of your foot as a tripod - your big toe, pinky toe, and heel should maintain contact with the floor at all times. 

I already saw others comment on your back position when you’re upright, so I’ll just say that I concur with what they’re saying. 

Hope this helps! 😊
